title: Wirelessblock
description: Adds WirelessRedstone to your World, link your Controller to your Redstone and Controll it Wireless.
body:
# Wireless Redstone

> Control your redstone creations completely wirelessly in Minecraft.

Wireless Redstone adds a modern wireless signal system to Minecraft, allowing you to connect redstone components without long lines of dust. Create wireless controllers, link supported blocks, and build clean, compact, and futuristic redstone systems.

![Preview](https://i.postimg.cc/K85F2q7T/ezgif-44f228c21122b36a.gif)
---
## Features

### Wireless Controllers

Craft and place wireless controllers that can transmit redstone signals to linked blocks.

### Wireless Connections

Connect supported blocks to a controller by sneaking while placing.

Supported blocks currently include:

* Redstone Lamps
* Copper Bulbs
* Iron Doors
* Iron Trapdoors

---

### Particle Visualizations

Animated particle lines visually display connections between the base controller and linked blocks.

### Glowing Highlights

Controllers and connected targets glow temporarily when linked, making setup easier and more intuitive.

---

### Link Management

Each controller supports configurable limits for:

* Maximum linked blocks
* Maximum wireless range

### Commands

```text
/wr list     #Shows All Controllers with the ability to delete them.
```

---

## How It Works

**1. Craft a Wireless Controller**

![Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51be87a66f205aa022674097ce6717f5e37d3f01.png)

The controller is crafted as a Waxed Copper Bulb.

**2. Place the Controller**

Place the controller block to create the wireless base.

**3. Add Wireless Targets**

Sneak while placing with the controller item to link supported redstone blocks.

**4. Activate Your System**

When the controller receives power, linked blocks activate wirelessly.

---

## Visual Effects

Wireless Redstone includes:

* Animated particle connection beams
* Temporary glowing outlines
* Placement feedback
* Action bar status messages
* Sound feedback

---

## Configuration

The plugin supports configurable settings such as:

```yaml
wb_max_targets: 5
wb_max_range: 32 currently in Implementation
```

---

## Planned Features

* More supported redstone blocks
* GUI management system
* Channel/frequency support
* Advanced wireless networks
* Permission support
* Better visualization effects

---

## Why Wireless Redstone?

Wireless Redstone makes complex redstone builds cleaner, easier to manage, and far more compact. No more giant tunnels full of redstone dust — build modern wireless systems with visual feedback and simple setup.

Perfect for:

* Technical servers
* Survival builds
* Adventure maps
* Mini-games
* Futuristic bases
* Compact automation systems
